title: En el trabajo
blurbEn: Ana's working day, with more regular verbs in action — including the -ir group you have not met yet.
body:
Trabajo en una oficina pequeña. Llego a las nueve y empiezo a trabajar.

Escribo correos y hablo con muchas personas.

A las dos como con mis compañeros. Comemos en un restaurante cerca de la oficina.

Por la tarde leo mucho.
translationEn:
I work in a small office. I arrive at nine and start working.

I write emails and speak with many people.

At two I eat with my colleagues. We eat in a restaurant near the office.

In the afternoon I read a lot.

escribo.note: 'escribir' is an -ir verb. In the 'I' form, -er and -ir verbs look identical: como, escribo.

tarde.note: The same word you met as 'late'. 'Por la tarde' means in the afternoon.

phrases.note: 'empezar a' + verb is how Spanish says 'start doing' something.
